name: Estrategia Nacional de Seguridad Digital de Colombia 2025-2027
owner: Departamento Nacional de Planeación — Consejo Nacional de Política Económica y Social (CONPES)
description: Estrategia Nacional de Seguridad Digital de Colombia 2025–2027 (MinTIC, January 2025). Colombia's national cybersecurity and digital security strategies adopted via CONPES policy documents and MinTIC, establishing ColCERT, CSIRT-CCIT, critical infrastructure protection, and digital trust governance.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Departamento Nacional de Planeación — Consejo Nacional de Política Económica y Social (CONPES) (dnp.gov.co) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Departamento Nacional de Planeación — Consejo Nacional de Política Económica y Social (CONPES) (dnp.gov.co).
